name: Burbidge and colleagues on stellar element synthesis
description: Burbidge, Burbidge, Fowler and Hoyle synthesized a theoretical account of how diverse nuclear processes in stars produce many elements.

date.basis: Year of the cited publication or dated report; not necessarily the date work began.

events.statement: The four authors published Synthesis of the Elements in Stars in 1957.
